Instruction: Generate code that solves a FOCUS-like Stage II coil optimization problem for finite build coils using the simsopt library. The code should also include the initialization of the boundary magnetic surface, creation of equally spaced curves and multifilament grid, application of stellarator and rotation symmetries, and definition of the Biot-Savart law.
